# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native mobile portrait arcade game titled **Chomp Circuit: Ghost Grid**. Preserve the source mechanics: a player avatar moves horizontally inside a bounded vertical lane using ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/A/D or tap-left/tap-right touch controls; hazards descend from the top; collectibles descend from the top; each collectible adds 100 points; speed escalates gradually; collision with a hazard immediately ends the run; start and restart are button-driven overlays.

Reinterpret the loop as a Pac-Man-inspired neon maze sprint. The player is a yellow chomper with an animated mouth. Hazards are bright ghosts with eyes and scalloped bodies. Collectibles are glowing pellets. The HUD shows Pellet score and Ghost Rush. Failure copy says Ghost Tag. The scene is a procedural maze corridor with blue/cyan rails, pellet tracks, gate motifs, retro glow, and portrait-first readability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a single-canvas arcade score runner: the player moves left/right inside a bounded vertical lane, hazards descend from the top, collectibles descend from the top, collecting a reward adds 100 points, contact with a hazard ends the run, and speed increases gradually over time. Input is keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/A/D plus touch-left/touch-right on the canvas. Start and restart are DOM buttons. Audio is unlocked by user gesture.

## Protected Mechanics
- Horizontal-only player movement within a bounded play lane.
- Random falling hazards and random falling collectibles.
- Axis-aligned rectangle collision detection.
- +100 score per collected reward.
- Hazard collision triggers immediate failure and restart path.
- Gradual speed escalation during active play.
- Keyboard and mobile touch semantics.

## Remixed Target
Chomp Circuit reframes the same loop as a portrait-first Pac-Man-inspired neon maze sprint. The player is a yellow chomper avatar, hazards are rushing ghosts, collectibles are glowing pellets, score is pellet count/score, and failure is being tagged by a ghost. The background is procedural arcade maze circuitry rather than a roadway.

## Presentation Surfaces Transformed
Title, HUD vocabulary, focal actor, hazards, rewards, background, feedback popups, color language, typography, and mobile prompt copy are rebuilt. The canonical implementation is the new inline `index.html`; `index_old.html` is reference-only.

identity.title: Chomp Circuit: Ghost Grid

identity.identity: A portrait neon maze sprint where a yellow chomper races through a ghost grid collecting pellets and dodging descending ghosts.
